recipe.eval_cadence: every epoch: full Train, full Valid, full official Test
recipe.loss: masked BCEWithLogitsLoss over observed entries only
recipe.scheduler: 1-epoch linear warmup then per-step cosine over the 40-epoch horizon
recipe.selection: highest full official Valid macro AP within the common horizon, ties -> earlier epoch
recipe.test_policy: official Test targets are NaN in the label artifact and are never indexed
